name: Momochi Asuka
source:
Asuka loves playing basketball and eats large amounts of food. She is often seen carrying a basketball around, but she also plays other sports like soccer. Asuka is part of the Disciplinary Committee and is often bullied by [url=/c98574]Kaede[/url], who is also in the Disciplinary Committee. Asuka is friends with [url=/c98546]Botan[/url], who calls her "Komacchi-senpai".

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
